details.question: 2011年11月的商品正向交易金额是多少
details.model_sql:

AND DATE_TRUNC('month', invoice_date) = '2011-11-01'
LIMIT 100;

details.question: 2011年11月取消金额占正向金额的比例是多少

details.question: 2011年11月的正向金额、取消金额、净额和订单数分别是多少
details.model_sql:
SELECT
  ROUND(SUM(line_amount) FILTER (WHERE include_product_sales), 2) AS 正向金额,
  ROUND(-SUM(line_amount) FILTER (WHERE include_product_cancellations), 2) AS 取消金额,
  ROUND(SUM(line_amount) FILTER (WHERE include_product_sales OR include_product_cancellations), 2) AS 交易净额,
  COUNT(DISTINCT invoice_no) FILTER (WHERE include_product_sales) AS 正向订单数

details.question: 2011年11月金额最高的10个客户占全部正向金额的比例
details.model_sql:
SELECT 
    ROUND((top10_sum / total_sum) * 100, 2) AS "2011年11月金额最高的10个客户占全部正向金额的比例(%)"
FROM (
    SELECT SUM(line_amount) AS total_sum
    FROM analytics.transactions
    WHERE source_batch = '20260917T121850_455264Z'
      AND include_product_sales
      AND invoice_date >= '2011-11-01' 
      AND invoice_date < '2011-12-01'
) t_total,
(
    SELECT SUM(cust_amt) AS top10_sum
    FROM (
        SELECT SUM(line_amount) AS cust_amt
        FROM analytics.transactions
        WHERE source_batch = '20260917T121850_455264Z'
          AND include_customer_sales
          AND invoice_date >= '2011-11-01' 
          AND invoice_date < '2011-12-01'
        GROUP BY customer_id
        ORDER BY cust_amt DESC
        LIMIT 10
    ) t_top10_cust
) t_top10
LIMIT 100;
